Test Case ID: Scenario A - Post Moderation and Approval Workflow

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login as school_admin; 2) Navigate to /school-admin/posts (page "Quản lý bài viết"); 3) Page loads with tabs (Tất cả, Trường, Giáo viên, Phụ huynh) and status filter cards; 4) Status filter = "all"; 5) View posts list
Expected Results: Page loads; Status 200; Posts displayed in feed format; Status filter cards visible with counts (Tất cả, Chờ duyệt, Đã duyệt, Từ chối); Tabs work correctly
Pre-conditions: School admin logged in; Posts exist in system

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) At /school-admin/posts; 3) Click status card "Chờ duyệt" OR use status filter dropdown; 4) List shows only pending posts
Expected Results: Only posts with status="pending" displayed; Status card "Chờ duyệt" highlighted/active; Count matches pending posts

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) At posts list, filter status = "Chờ duyệt"; 3) Click on pending post to open detail/card; 4) Find and click button "Duyệt" or "Approve" (color=success); 5) Confirmation dialog appears; 6) Confirm; 7) Post status changes to "approved"
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Duyệt thành công"; Post moves to "Đã duyệt" list; Post visible to public (parents/teachers); Post creator gets notification; Status badge on PostCard changes color from warning to success

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Filter status = "Chờ duyệt"; 3) Open post detail/card; 4) Click button "Từ chối" or "Reject" (color=error); 5) Dialog "Từ chối bài viết" appears with TextField for rejection reason; 6) Enter reason; 7) Click "Xác nhận" or "Từ chối"; 8) Post status = "rejected"
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Từ chối thành công"; Post removed from public list; Moves to "Từ chối" list; Creator notified with rejection reason; Status badge changes to red/error

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login school_admin; 2) At /school-admin/posts click button "Tạo bài viết"; 3) CreatePostModal opens; 4) Fill Title, Content, optionally upload images; 5) Set status = "Đã duyệt" or just click "Đăng"; 6) Click "Đăng bài"; 7) Modal closes
Expected Results: Status 201; Toast "Đăng bài thành công"; Post appears immediately in "Đã duyệt" list; Post visible to all users; Creates with status="approved"

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post detail/card; 3) Click button "Chỉnh sửa" (EditIcon); 4) CreatePostModal opens pre-filled; 5) Update content or images; 6) Click "Cập nhật"; 7) Modal closes
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Cập nhật thành công"; Post updated in feed with new content; Last edit timestamp recorded; Visible immediately if already approved
Pre-conditions: Post exists; Edit permission (author or admin)

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post; 3) Click button "Xóa" or "Delete" (icon or menu); 4) Confirmation dialog "Xác nhận xóa bài viết?"; 5) Click "Xóa"
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Xóa thành công"; Post removed from list immediately; Comments and likes associated with post removed; Post not visible in archive (hard delete or soft delete per BR)

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post that has images attached; 3) Click on image thumbnail or gallery icon; 4) GalleryModal opens (slideshow/carousel)
Expected Results: Status 200; Images render correctly without load errors; Can swipe/arrow navigate; Zoom/fullscreen works; Comments visible below images

Test Case ID: Scenario B - Comment and Like Moderation

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post detail/card; 3) Look for section "Bình luận" or tab/button "Xem bình luận"; 4) Click to expand or open CommentModal; 5) Comments list loads
Expected Results: Status 200; All comments for post displayed in list; Shows author name, avatar, timestamp, comment text; Ordered by date (newest or oldest per config)

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post; 3) At comment section, on problematic comment click "Xóa" button (DeleteIcon); 4) Confirmation dialog; 5) Click "Xóa"
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Xóa bình luận thành công"; Comment removed from list; Comment count decrements; Commenter optionally notified of deletion

Test Case Description: View list of likes for post
Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post; 3) Click on like count number or like icon (to toggle like + view modal); 4) LikesModal opens with list of users who liked
Expected Results: Status 200; Modal shows list of users who liked post; Each entry: Avatar + Name; Total count matches displayed like count; Can close and re-open

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open post detail/card; 3) Find "Cài đặt bài viết" or settings menu; 4) Toggle "Cho phép bình luận" = Off; 5) Click "Lưu"
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Cập nhật thành công"; Comment form hidden/disabled on post; Old comments remain visible but can't add new; Toggle reflects current state (On/Off)

Test Case ID: Scenario C - Complaint Management and Resolution

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login school_admin; 2) Navigate to /school-admin/complaints (page "Quản lý đơn khiếu nại"); 3) Dashboard loads with stat cards; 4) Observe cards: "Tất cả", "Đang chờ", "Đã duyệt", "Từ chối"; 5) Optional: Select category tab (Tất cả, Giáo viên, Phụ huynh)
Expected Results: Page loads; Status 200; 4 stat cards displayed with counts and color-coded icons (warning=yellow for pending, success=green for approved, error=red for rejected); Totals match complaint counts; Cards clickable to filter

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) At /school-admin/complaints page; 3) Status filter = "Tất cả"; 4) View complaint table; 5) Optional: Use pagination/scroll to view all
Expected Results: Status 200; Complaints displayed in TableContainer format; Columns: Date/Time, Type, Title, From (teacher/parent name), Status (Chip badge), Actions; Pagination works if > 10 complaints

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) In complaint list click a row; 3) Detail dialog/drawer opens
Expected Results: Status 200; Displays: Type, Title, Description, Status (Chip badge), Creator info (name, role), Student name (if applicable), Created timestamp, Last updated timestamp; Response text (if exists)

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Filter complaints by status "Đang chờ" or status tab = 1 (pending); 3) Open complaint detail dialog; 4) Click button "Duyệt đơn" (color=success) if status=pending; 5) TextField appears for "Nội dung xử lý" (response); 6) Enter resolution; 7) Click "Xác nhận" or "Lưu"
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Xử lý thành công"; Complaint status changes to "approved"; Response text saved; Dialog closes; List updates; Complaint moves to "Đã duyệt" list; Creator notified with resolution text
Pre-conditions: Complaint in "Đang chờ" status; Approval permission

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Filter "Đang chờ"; 3) Open complaint detail; 4) Click button "Từ chối đơn" (color=error); 5) TextField for reason appears; 6) Enter rejection reason; 7) Click "Xác nhận"
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Từ chối thành công"; Status changes to "rejected"; Reason saved; Moves to "Từ chối" list; Creator notified with reason

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open pending complaint; 3) Find status selector or button "Đang xử lý"; 4) Set/click to mark as in-progress; 5) Click "Lưu"
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Cập nhật thành công"; Complaint status = "in_progress" or similar; Parent sees processing status; List shows updated status

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Open complaint detail; 3) Find section "Ghi chú nội bộ" or "Internal Notes"; 4) TextField input for note; 5) Add text; 6) Click "Lưu" or auto-save
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Ghi chú đã lưu"; Note stored and visible in list for admins only; Not sent to parent; Timestamp recorded

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login school_admin; 2) Navigate to /school-admin/settings or complaints page; 3) Find "Loại khiếu nại" or "Complaint Types" section/tab; 4) Click to view list
Expected Results: Status 200; List of complaint types displayed (table or list); Shows name, description, category (teacher/parent or "all")

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) At "Loại khiếu nại" section; 3) Click "Thêm loại khiếu nại" button; 4) Dialog opens; 5) Fill name, description, select categories (checkboxes: teacher, parent); 6) Click "Lưu"
Expected Results: Status 201; Toast "Thêm thành công"; New type appears in list immediately; Available in complaint form dropdown for users

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login school_admin; 2) Navigate to /school-admin/complaints; 3) Click button "Quản lý loại đơn"; 4) Dialog opens showing complaint types table; 5) In table, click button "Chỉnh sửa" (pencil icon ni ni-ruler-pencil) on the type row; 6) Dialog title changes to "Chỉnh sửa loại đơn"; 7) Form pre-fills with type name, description, and category checkboxes; 8) Update description or category selections; 9) Click "Lưu" button
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Cập nhật loại đơn thành công!"; Dialog closes; Type list updates immediately; Changes reflected in complaint form dropdown

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login school_admin; 2) Navigate to /school-admin/complaints; 3) Click button "Quản lý loại đơn"; 4) Dialog opens with complaint types table; 5) Locate type with NO linked complaints; 6) In that row, click delete button "Xóa" (trash icon ni ni-fat-remove, color red); 7) Confirmation dialog appears "Bạn có chắc muốn xóa loại đơn này?"; 8) Click "Xác nhận" or "Xóa"
Expected Results: Status 200; Toast "Xóa loại đơn thành công!"; Type removed from table immediately; Type removed from complaint form dropdown; No longer available for new complaints

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) Select type that IS used in complaints; 3) Click "Xóa"
Expected Results: Button disabled OR Error dialog: "Loại khiếu nại đang được sử dụng. Không thể xóa." (400 error); Type not deleted

Test Case Procedure: 1) Login; 2) At complaint types list; 3) Drag-drop to reorder types; 4) Click "Lưu thứ tự"; 5) Observe order change in form
Expected Results: New order saved and persists; Order reflected in complaint creation form dropdown (if applicable)
Pre-conditions: Multiple types exist; Reorder feature enabled
